videos.title: Campfire, Jackal and Rising Glyphs | Kush at Night, Ambient Dub #shorts
videos.description:
A campfire burns on the dune, a jackal crosses the crest, and glyphs climb into the sky to become stars.

A 3-minute moment from "Kush – Meroë at Dusk," a 2-hour ambient space dub visualizer. Binaural movement, deep dub tape delays, no words. Best with headphones.

Visuals coded in HTML, recorded and rendered by Seiler Asterces.
Music composed and performed by Secrets Are Lies in Logic Pro.

#ambi

videos.title: Red Cloud's War from Red Cloud's Side | Hundred in the Hand (iPhone game in development)
videos.description:
December 21, 1866. Ten decoys have to draw the soldiers out of Fort Phil Kearny, over Lodge Trail Ridge, and into the valley where the Lakota, Northern Cheyenne and Arapaho are waiting. Stay too far ahead and the soldiers go home. Stay too close and the decoys are shot.

This is the first playable stage of Hundred in the Hand, a one-thumb strategy game about the war that closed the Bozeman Trail,

videos.title: 0 to 100 in Ember Ascent 🔥 One Thumb, One Minute #shorts
videos.description:
A full run of Ember Ascent, 0 to 100, in under a minute.

Tap to let go. Catch the next ring before your light fades. The dark rises behind you.

Ember Ascent is a one-thumb vertical game in development for iPhone. The sound is the game's own: a low drone and chimes through a dub delay, played by your taps.

Would you play this? Tell me in the comments.
